verdict.rationale: Ledgy's docs show a cap table that can hold imported historical transactions with documents attached (ledgy-docs-7), retrievable through the companyCaptable and companyTransactions API operations (ledgy-docs-6, ledgy-docs-30). Option and share-award grants with vesting schedules are covered (ledgy-docs-11, ledgy-docs-12), and auditor-oriented IFRS 2/GAAP reporting is available (ledgy-docs-13), but several named instruments and the investor-facing side have no evidence at all. Missing for 10: explicit support for share classes, share certificates and SAFEs/convertibles, investor access to the cap table as a source of truth, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
